title: Cold rebuild: can this reader read that writer?
summary: Rebuild the schema resolution check from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **CanRead** in *JSON, Avro, Protobuf and the schema registry*. Now write it
again from an **empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Every compatibility mode in the registry is this
one function called in a different direction, so it is worth owning.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Warm-up: a producer adds `channel` (string, **no default**) to `OrderPlaced`. Which mode rejects it?
options: `BACKWARD`: the new schema cannot read old records, which have no `channel`
`FORWARD`: old readers cannot skip the new field
Neither: adding a field is always safe
explain: Under BACKWARD the new reader must decode old data, and old data has no value for a field without a default. Old
readers simply ignore an extra field, so FORWARD accepts it.

steps.title: Rebuild CanRead cold
prompt: The tests define `record Field(string Name, string Type, bool HasDefault);`
Write `bool CanRead(List<Field> reader, List<Field> writer)`: can a consumer with the `reader` schema decode data
- every reader field exists in the writer with the same name and type, or (missing in the writer) has a default;
- writer fields the reader does not know are ignored.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty.
